messages:
Marie: quick heads up — NovaTech renewal coming up. want to rebaseline their commit mid-term. current commit is $50k/yr, their current run-rate is ~ $140k/yr. proposing new commit $125k/yr with a 12% committed discount for the committed volume. need guidance on: rate-card tier, whether deal desk will approve a midterm commit change, and if we can issue pro-rated credits for months they've already paid. cc @Jonas @Rachel :eyes:

Jonas: thanks. can you paste the opportunity id and current invoice schedule? also which product mix — hosted vs dedicated? that affects pricing slab.

Marie: OP-8793. product mix is mostly hosted for inference with a small Dedicated pool for heavy batch jobs (~20% of tokens). invoices are quarterly, last invoice posted 2025-09-01 for Q3. customer asks to move to annual commit asap.

Eitan (SE): from infra POV: if they increase commit we need to confirm dedicated pool sizing for the 20% burst. POC last month showed sustained GPU use at ~65% for batch windows. we can size + schedule but need a lead time of ~6 weeks for Dedicated nodes.

Rachel (SalesOps): OP-8793 noted. For pricing rules: midterm commit increases are allowed but require Deal Desk sign-off if discount >10% or if changing billing cadence. what's the proposed discount basis?

Marie: proposing 12% on committed tokens above $100k/yr threshold (so base $100k at standard rate, additional at discounted rate). asking if we can give a one-time credit to offset unused months of current quarter pro-rated to new annual price.

Priya (Solutions): alternative we often use — stepped commit: 3-month ramp (70% first month, 85% second, then full) and prorate billing, with a mid-year true-up. reduces churn risk and legal friction. also offer a performance SLI credit (token credits) if latency > SLO during first 90 days.

Samira (CSM): customer worried about audit and data isolation. if we move them to larger commit and keep some Dedicated, they want an updated SOW reflecting retention and encryption at rest in the Dedicated pool. we'll need to update SOW and attach to the amendment.

Rachel (SalesOps): copy of relevant rate-card snippet for context:
```
Tier A: 0-100k tokens/month -> $0.004/token
Tier B: 100k-1M tokens/month -> $0.0032/token
Tier C: 1M+ tokens/month -> $0.0026/token
Committed discount: applied only to committed volume above base threshold.
Special term: midterm commit change requires Deal Desk approval if discount >10% or if billing cadence changes.
```

LegalBot: Suggested amendment language (short):
"Customer and Company agree to amend the Agreement to reflect an adjusted committed purchase amount of $125,000 per year. The parties agree billing will transition to annual invoicing beginning on the effective date of this amendment. Any unused pre-paid months from the prior invoice cycle will be applied as a one-time credit to the first annual invoice. This amendment is subject to Deal Desk approval for the discounted pricing schedule."

Marie: perfect — thanks. can Deal Desk confirm if they'll approve the 12% discount + one-time credit? need answer by EOD Friday to keep our renewal timeline.

DealDeskBot: escalation received for OP-8793. please provide: final TCV, redlined SOW (if any), legal amendment draft, and the customer business justification for >10% discount. assign to DD-117. ETA for review: 48 business hours after docs received.

Jonas: I'll upload the SOW redline and business justification by EOD today. tagging @Rachel to prep the TCV calc and revenue impact.

Rachel (SalesOps): on it — will post TCV calc in the thread once done.

Marie: thanks everyone. if Deal Desk okays the midterm change we'll offer the stepped ramp from Priya and include the SLI credit. keeping CSM looped to finalize SOW edits.

Samira (CSM): I'll draft the SOW updates for retention and encryption and send to Legal for sign-off.

Jonas: escalation noted. Marie — remind me if customer insists on immediate annual invoice start date; we may need finance sign-off for revenue recognition.

Marie: noted. final ask — can we get Deal Desk decision by EOD Friday? customer is pushing for immediate change to avoid overage this quarter. :pray:

DealDeskBot: acknowledged. will confirm timeline after receipt of docs (DD-117).

Marie: thanks — close loop after docs uploaded. :thumbsup:
